captions.go: Lift your leg out to the side

steps.text: Stand beside a chair and hold it.
Lift one leg out to the side, with the knee straight and the toes pointing forward.
Keep your body upright: do not lean away from the leg.
Lower it slowly. Then do the same with the other leg.

safety: Hold the chair the whole time.
Do not lean your body to the side.

mistakes.label: trunk_lean
mistakes.wrong: your body leaned to the side
mistakes.right: Keep your body upright; do not lean away from the lifting leg.

mistakes.label: leg_forward
mistakes.wrong: your leg went forwards instead of straight out to the side
mistakes.right: Lift the leg straight out to the side, not forwards.

setup: Face the phone, with the chair beside you.
